column2: Give Jubei back!
Beat me and maybe I'll give her back!
Waaah, that was so scaaary!
There, there. You're all right now.
You saved not just Yamagishi-kun but me too... I've got to repay you somehow!\n\nI'm a descendant of the Yagyu ninja too! I always repay a favor!
That's right! I ain't gonna feel square leaving it like this either! If you're ever in a bind, just say the word!
Why not ask them, now that we're here?
Maybe we'll get some kind of clue.
Yeah. Actually...
Whaaat!?
...What a strange story.
A black moon and the Kanto Hellquake? And a mansion floating on Hasunuma? Sounds like a blast...!
It's not supposed to be a blast! We've got to help solve the mystery!
Ah, Boss! How could you leave me behind!
Defy me and see what happens!
Help me, would ya...
Let me go! Cross me and my quick draw does the talkin'!
Yamagishi-kun, aren't we fwiends? Let's all play nicey-nice! Ohohoho!
Thanks, everybody!
Hey, Boss, did you hear? They say a monster shows up in the gym storeroom!
A monster!? That sounds like a blast too!
Hey, {p}, wanna go check out the gym storeroom?
Good idea. It might have something to do with Hasunuma.
What? The key to the gym storeroom? Don't know, don't know!
The gym storeroom key?\n\nA drifter who don't know if he'll see tomorrow wouldn't know about that!
I don't have the gym storeroom key, darling! It's in my pocket, but I don't have it!
It's in your pocket... huh?
Sometimes you hear voices coming from the gym storeroom. Did the teachers lock somebody in there?
Serves those creeps right! Welp, time for lunch!
Yamagishi-kun, you're leaving?\n\nIt'll be lonely, but maybe it'll be nice and quiet for a while...?
Whaddaya mean by that!?
Kyaaa!
Jubei... Yamagishi-kun... Take care.
I'm gonna study really hard and then... I'll become a teacher at Harenchi Gakuen!
The teachers are gone, so how about a campfire in the classroom!
When did they get up on the school roof!?
It's locked. It won't open.\n\nBut it looks like a normal gym storeroom...?
That's weird. It's usually open...?
Those who throw the school into chaos have joined... And those who cross between worlds join next...
Yikes! We're locked in!
Nooo, let us out!
Pipe dooown!
Oh, there was somebody in here! Huh?
Wait, that kid...?
Whoaaa! A kappa!?
What's with these folks...?
Kapaeru, what're you making a racket about?
These folks are the ones makin' the racket, I do declare.
Wh-who are you?
We came from the Hell World to hunt yokai!
Hunt yokai?
The Hell World?
I'm Enma.
I'm Kapaeru.
And I'm Princess Yukiko.
And I'm Chapeau-jii, my boy! Hyohyohyo!
Hmm!?\n\nYou guys are possessed by a yokai, aren't ya?
My eyebrows are antennae for sniffing out yokai. And those antennae are picking up yokai energy from your bodies, see?
Th-then I'm... possessed by a yokai!?
Could it be my house vanished because I'm cursed...?
Something weird must've happened. Tell me about it.
Actually...
Actually! Where my house should be, there's a pond! And on top of that... they say when a black moon rises, a mansion floats on that pond!
Gyahahaha!\n\nA mansion floats on a pond when a black moon comes out!?
Don't laugh so much, that's rude!
If you wanna go to that mansion, head back to the pond. See ya!
When the black moon shines, let us meet... Could that e-mail have been from Enma-kun...?
Looks like it.
I feel like the teachers are as bad as the students... but we can't just leave him tied to a post, can we?
Right!? Will you all help me?
Yeah. Let's go save Yamagishi-kun!
Speaking of unusual, that school there's unusual. The teachers and students have energy to burn, and they need an ambulance every day.
I know some weird folks. A crime family that'd scare a crying kid quiet. The father's a psychic, the sons are a pervert, a cyborg and a bomber. But the eldest daughter's a real cutie!
It suddenly got dark...
It's still daytime, ain't it?
Look! The moon's reflected on the water!
It's the black moon!
Whoa!
Over here, over here!
It's {s}, all right!
Hurry up and come on!
Thank goodness... She's okay!
Welcome! We've been waiting for you!
What the heck is this? Creepy doorbell, huh?
It's really well made. Just like a real oni!
Welcome to Hell Villa!
Eek!?
I-it's real!?
You're okay...
The road got blocked off... I was worried about you!
Me too! But I'm so glad we found each other!
{p} was worried about you the whole time, too.
Honey! You're all right too! Did you get to see your father...?
Yes... well...
{s}, let's talk about that later...
Right. Enma-kun is waiting for you, {p}. Let's go!
